title: Ebola Outbreak Tracker Update — May 24, 2026
summary: The 2026 Bundibugyo virus outbreak has escalated to PHEIC status, with WHO making an unprecedented declaration on May 17 without prior Emergency Committee consultation. Suspected cases have surged to ~750 across three DRC provinces (Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu) with 177 suspected deaths, while Uganda confirmed 5 imported cases in Kampala. Attacks on Ebola treatment centers in Rwampara (May 21) and Mongbwalu (May 22) — the latter causing 18 suspected patients to flee into the community — represent critical setbacks to containment. No licensed Bundibugyo-specific vaccine exists, and WHO has raised DRC's risk level to 'Very High.'

title: Ebola Outbreak Tracker Update — Sat May 23, 2026
summary: Uganda confirmed three additional cases of Bundibugyo virus disease, bringing the country's total to five. US Reroutes Passengers from DRC, Uganda, South Sudan to 3 Airports for Ebola Screening.

title: Ebola Outbreak Tracker Update — Fri May 22, 2026
summary: The WHO IHR Emergency Committee issued formal temporary recommendations following its first meeting, advising affected countries and all states parties on the Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) epidemic. Angry residents arrived at the MSF-operated Ebola Treatment Unit in Mongbwalu, Ituri Province, on the night of 22 May and set fire to a tent housing suspected and confirmed Ebola cases. US Embassy Kampala Issues Health Alert as WHO Raises DRC Risk to Very High.

title: Ebola Outbreak Tracker Update — Thu May 21, 2026
summary: Protesters Set Rwampara Ebola Treatment Unit on Fire in Ituri Province. First South Kivu Case Confirmed — Outbreak Spreads to Third DRC Province.

title: Ebola Outbreak Tracker Update — Tue May 19, 2026
